Should flag

Narrow justified paragraph, no hyphenation

300px column, about 37 characters per line

Forcing every line of a column this narrow out to the same width leaves only a handful of word spaces to carry the slack, so each one opens up until the gaps line up vertically and a river of white runs down the paragraph.

Narrow justified paragraph with hyphens: manual

260px column, hyphenation only where the author typed a soft hyphen

Setting hyphens to manual leaves the breaking to the author, so an unmarked word still travels whole to the next line and the line it left behind stretches to cover the distance it used to fill.

Justified sidebar column

240px sidebar, about 30 characters per line

A sidebar is the worst place to justify: the measure is short enough that a single long word pushed to the next line doubles every remaining space on the line above it.

Narrow justified paragraph set in one span

280px column, every word inside an inline span

Wrapping the whole paragraph in a span changes nothing about its lines: the paragraph still sets them at its narrow measure and stretches the few word spaces each one holds.

Narrow paragraph with a one-line lead-in and a long emphasis

240px column, the paragraph's own words on one line, the rest in an em

See the note below here: Justified lines in a narrow column stretch the spaces between words until rivers of white run down the page and break the reading rhythm.

Should pass

Justified at a long measure

760px column, about 95 characters per line

At a long measure there are enough word spaces on every line that the leftover width spreads thinly across all of them, which is why books and newspapers have justified comfortably for centuries without anyone seeing a river in the page.

Links inside a justified paragraph at a long measure

760px column; the links inherit justify but are set on the paragraph's lines

The links in a long paragraph, such as this reference to an earlier chapter or an underlined title of a paper, take the measure of the paragraph around them, whose lines are long enough to absorb the stretch.

One-line heading in a narrow column

Research topics

Narrow justified paragraph with hyphens: auto

300px column, automatic hyphenation on

With automatic hyphenation the browser breaks the long words itself, so every line ends close to the margin already and justification has almost nothing left to stretch.

300px column, characters of uniform width

永慶房屋於一九八八年成立，專注本業，堅持創新，秉持先誠實再成交的精神，提供消費者透明的資訊與安心的服務，目前在雙北地區有逾二百八十家直營門市。
